mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_voucher_order_process (order_id, user_id, voucher_id, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{voucherId}, 'PENDING') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id = order_id
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, voucher_id, status FROM tb_voucher_order_process WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
